report:
Findings:  No joint effusion or intra-articular loose bodies. No sinister bone marrow changes.  Loculated ganglion is noted along the posterolateral aspect of the distal diametaphysis of femur and extending into the popliteal fossa is again noted and remains largely unchanged on comparison to previous MRI dated [DATE].  Intact cruciate and collateral ligaments.  Mucoid degeneration of the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus however no discrete tear.  Incomplete discoid lateral meniscus. Horizontal tear involving the body, anterior and posterior horns of the lateral meniscus with a few associated small (~5 mm) para meniscal cysts.  Normal appearance of the pes anserine tendons, popliteus tendon, distal biceps femoris tendon and distal iliotibial band.  Intact extensor mechanism. No evidence of fat pad impingement.  Relatively well maintained tricompartmental hyaline articular cartilage.  
Conclusion:  Incomplete discoid lateral meniscus. Horizontal tear involving the body, anterior and posterior horns of the lateral meniscus with a few small (~5 mm) associated para meniscal cysts. Ancillary findings above.

Interprétation:

Épanchement intra-articulaire modéré. Pas de kyste de Baker significatif.

Il y a une déchirure légèrement complexe du ménisque interne avec une composante périphérique verticale/radiaire de la corne postérieure avec possiblement une lésion de type RAMP associée à la jonction ménisco-capsulaire. Il y a une composante longitudinale oblique s’étendant jusqu’à la jonction avec le corps méniscal. Minime extrusion du corps méniscal. 

Il y a un léger œdème au pourtour du ligament collatéral interne en lien avec une entorse de grade 1. Il y a une atténuation diffuse légère à modérée des surfaces cartilagineuses au compartiment fémoro-tibial interne avec petits ostéophytes marginaux. Il y a un minime foyer d’œdème au versant interne du condyle fémoral interne probablement de nature contusionnelle. Pas d’atteinte transfixiante ou de changement sous-chondral réactionnel. 

Petits kystes ganglionnaires à l’origine des gastrocnémiens.

Le ménisque externe et le complexe ligamentaire collatéral externe sont intacts sans déchirure. Légère atténuation diffuse des surfaces chondrales au compartiment fémoro-tibial externe avec petits ostéophytes marginaux. Pas d’atteinte transfixiante. 

Le ligament croisé postérieur est intact sans déchirure. Il y a suspicion d’une déchirure transfixiante probablement de la portion moyenne distal du ligament croisé antérieur avec contusion probablement associée au versant postérieur des plateaux tibiaux externe et interne.

L’alignement patello-fémoral est préservé. 

Petits enthésophytes à l’insertion distal du quadriceps avec légère tendinose/enthésopathie. Pas de déchirure. Le tendon patellaire est intact sans déchirure.

Il y a une atténuation légère à modérée des surfaces chondrales au compartiment patello-fémoral avec foyers focaux de chondropathie de grade 4 le long de la facette patellaire interne et de la trochlée interne avec fissures transfixiantes et minimes changements sous-chondraux réactionnels associés. Petits ostéophytes marginaux.

Conclusion:

Déchirure d’allure complète du ligament croisé antérieur avec contusion probablement résiduelle associée de la portion postérieure des plateaux tibiaux externe et interne.

Déchirure complexe de la corne postérieure du ménisque interne avec composante périphérique verticale/radiaire avec possiblement une lésion de type RAMP associée à la jonction ménisco-capsulaire de même qu’une composante longitudinale oblique s’étendant au corps méniscal. 

Chondropathie tricompartimentale diffuse de grade 1-2 avec foyers focaux de chondropathie de grade 4 au versant interne du compartiment patello-fémoral.

Épanchement intra-articulaire modéré.

Autres trouvailles telles que décrites ci-haut.

RIGHT KNEE MRI 

CLINICAL INDICATION: Rule out meniscal tear of the right knee, chondrosis

Technique: Multiplanar PD, PF fat sat and T1 imaging was acquired through the knee. 

Comparison: Radiograph of the right knee [Date]

Findings:

General:
Marrow:  normal
Effusion:  none

Menisci:   
Medial meniscus:   normal
Lateral meniscus:   The undersurface of the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus demonstrates abnormal signal, involving the lateral aspect of the posterior horn and posterior body. No discrete surfacing tears. Finding is consistent with a undersurface degenerative meniscal flap tear. Mild associated extrusion of the lateral meniscus.

Ligaments and tendons:
Cruciate ligaments:   normal
Medial collateral ligament:   normal
Lateral collateral ligament:   normal
Popliteofibular ligament:   normal
Other posterolateral corner ligaments:   normal
Popliteal tendon:   There is increased fluid signal along the myotendinous junction of the popliteal tendon. A ganglion cyst surrounding the myotendinous junction and popliteus measures about 2 x 2.3 x 0.6 cm.
Iliotibial band:   normal

Extensor mechanism:
Quadriceps tendon:   normal
Patella:   normal. TTG within normal limits. No trochlear dysplasia.
Patellar tendon:   normal
Hoffa?s fat pad:   normal

Cartilage:
Patellofemoral joint: Cartilaginous thinning with fissuring in both the patellar and trochlear aspects in keeping with in keeping with moderate chondrosis
Medial compartment: Areas of thinning affecting both the femoral and tibial surfaces in keeping with mild to moderate chondrosis.
Lateral compartment: There is a fraying and irregularity of the lateral compartment cartilage, affecting both the femoral and tibial aspects in keeping with moderate chondrosis.

Other:
Osteophytes in the lateral femoral condyle, lateral intracondylar notch. Small osteophyte in the medial femoral intracondylar notch.
Small Baker's cysts measuring up to 4 mm.


CONCLUSION:
1.	Degenerative lateral meniscal tear as described.
2.	Fluid signal along the myotendinous junction of the popliteus in keeping with popliteus tendinosis
3.	Moderate tricompartmental chondrosis. Early degenerative osteophyte formation to the lateral joint compartment.
4.	Incidental findings above

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: [REDACTED].
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. Intra-osseous ganglion cyst at the ACL and PCL insertion. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion with synovitis. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Oblique undersurface tear at the posterior horn lateral meniscus extending to the body. No extrusion or displaced fragments. 
Lateral compartment cartilage: Focal full thickness fissuring along the lateral tibial plateau near the tibial spine with subchondral cystic change.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Diffuse partial thickness cartilage loss with areas of high grade cartilage loss and full-thickness fissuring along the lateral patellar facet, median ridge and medial patellar facet with subchondral cystic change and marrow edema. Full-thickness cartilage loss along the central and lateral trochlea with subchondral marrow edema.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact. Mild mucoid degeneration. 
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal. Mild mucoid degeneration. 

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 14 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Oblique undersurface tear at the posterior horn lateral meniscus extending to the body.
2.	Severe patellofemoral and mild lateral compartment chondrosis.
3.	Small joint effusion with synovitis.

Kompleksna horizontalna i radijalna ruptura koja komunicira s artikulacijskom plohom tibije, u
području tijela i stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska (Parrot beak ruptura).
Prikaže se hondromalacija I° hrskavice medijalnog tibijalnog platoa. Hondromalacija III°
medijalnog femoralnog kondila.
Prikazane koštane strukture primjerenih intenziteta signala i morfologije.
Prikazana zglobna tijela primjereno su uzglobljena.
Prednji križni ligament pokazuje manji defekt vlakana na hvatištu za interkondilarnu eminenciju
tibije u smislu manje parcijalne rupture. Stražnji križni ligament održanog kontinuiteta i
primjerenih intenziteta signala.
Diskretno povišen intenzitet signala lateralnog meniska u smislu početnih degenerativnih
promjena.
Znakovi blage distenzije medijalnog kolateralnog ligamenta.
Lateralni kolateralni ligament diskretno povišenih intenziteta signala pri hvatištu za lateralni
epikondil femura, vjerojatno uslijed blažih entezopatskih promjena.
Moguća manja parcijalna ruptura tetive popliteusa na hvatištu za femur.
Uredan prikaz iliotibijalnog trakta i pes anserinus.
Tetiva kvadricepsa i patelarni ligament su primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Patelarni retinakulumi održani.
Umjereni izljev u zglobu.
Poplitealna cista aksijalno veličine oko 22x7 mm.

MRI of right Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS


> Increased interstitial signal of distal quadriceps tendon on F/S T2WI and incrased fat stranding over anterior suprapatellar fat pad, R/O grade 1 injury and suprapatellar fat pad inflammation.
> Suspicious of mild increased singal intensity of patellar articular cartialge on F/S T2WI, R/O grade 1 chondromalacia.
> The contour of ACL & PCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, without significant extending into the surface, in favor of grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus, maybe due to contusion or peripheral vascularity.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> No evidence of bone contusion is noted.
> Minimal joint effusion and suprapatellar plica.

Impression: 
1. Grade 1 injury of distal quadriceps tendon and anterior suprapatellar fat pad inflammation.
2. R/O grade 1 patellar chondromalacia.
3. No strong evidence of full thickness tear of ACL.
4. R/O grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus, maybe due to contusion or peripheral vascularity.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

Umjerene degenerativne promjene FT zgloba sa stanjenjem hrskavica, zonom denudacije u
području lateralnog kondila femura te hondromalcičnim promjenama 1.-2. stupnja.
Manje subhondralne ciste medijalnog kondila tibije.
Plića je trohleja femura ("sulcus angle" 160°) uz kut lateralne inklinacije od 7° i značajno manju
medijalnu fasetu, u sklopu displazije trohleje.
Posljedično izražene degenerativne promjene FP zgloba s gubitkom hrskavica faseta patele i
trohleje femura te zonama koštanog edema patele i lateralnog kondila femura anteriorno uz
prisutne subhondralne ciste.
Patella alta (Insall-Salvati omjer 1,7) uz lateralnu subluksaciju patele.
Straga uz PCL dva slobodna koštana tijela veličine oko 20x8 mm i 6x6 mm - sekundarna
sinovijalna hondromatoza?
Prednji križni ligament je umjereno degenerativno promijenjen, bez znakova rupture. Ganglion
cista veličine oko 8 mm uz proksimalno hvatište.
Stražnji križni ligament je primjerenih intenziteta signala, bez znakova rupture.
Medijalni menisk je degenerativno promijenjen, bez evidentne rupture.
Lateralni menisk je primjerenih intenziteta signala, bez znakova rupture.
Medijalni kolateralni ligament je blago distendiran, bez znakova rupture.
Entezopatske promjene proksimalnog hvatišta lateralnog kolateralnog ligamenta.
Entezopatske promjene i burzitis tetive m. popliteus.
Distenzija oba patelarna retinakuluma, bez znakova rupture.
Entezopatske promjene hvatišta tetive m. quadriceps.
Početne entezopatske promjene oba hvatišta patelarnog ligamenta.
Umjerena do značajna količina izljeva u zglobu, najizraženije u lateralnom i medijalnom recesusu
uz hipertrofiju sinovije.
Ne nalazi se znakova poplitealne ciste.

CONSTATATIONS :

Fractures :
Aucune.

Alignement articulaire :
Normal.

Changements dégénératifs :
Fissuration profonde et focale du cartilage à la jonction de la trochlée médiale et du condyle fémoral médial antérieur avec un petit foyer d'œdème osseux réactionnel.

Signal de la moelle osseuse :
Par ailleurs normal.

Ligament croisé antérieur : Normal.
Ligament croisé postérieur : Normal.
Ligament collatéral médial : Normal.
Complexe du ligament collatéral latéral : normal.

Ménisque médial : Normal.
Ménisque latéral : Normal.

Tendons extenseurs : Normal.
Rétinacula patellaire : Normal.
Pes anserinus : Normal.

Coin postéro-latéral et postérieur : Normal.

Épanchement articulaire : Pas de liquide significatif.
Kyste de Baker : Petit kyste de Baker non compliqué et collabé, non significatif.

Autres trouvailles significatives :
Aucune.

CONCLUSION :
Pas de déchirure méniscale ou ligamentaire.
Fissuration profonde et focale du cartilage à la jonction de la trochlée médiale et du condyle fémoral médial avec œdème osseux réactionnel, représentant probablement la source de la douleur.
Pas d'épanchement articulaire.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Left knee pain for one month. No known injury. No history of surgery.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture. Normal background marrow signal. No focal osseous lesion. Irregular exostosis at the posterior medial tibial plateau with associated thin T2 hyperintense cartilaginous lining, compatible with an osteochondroma.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. Small multiloculated Baker's cyst with internal debris.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Probable small oblique undersurface tear at the posterior horn without extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: Intact.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: No tear.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Low-grade articular cartilage loss at the posterior lateral femoral condyle.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Intact.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): No tear.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): No tear.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Extensor Apparatus: Normal quadriceps tendon. Normal patellar tendon.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance is 11 mm, normal.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No disproportionate muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Trace pes anserinus bursitis. Small ganglion cyst at the posterior lateral knee, in the region of the proximal popliteus tendon sheath. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Probable small oblique undersurface tear at the posterior horn of the medial meniscus without extrusion. 
2.	Small left knee effusion with a small multiloculated Baker's cyst.
3.	Mild pes anserinus bursitis.
4.	Osteochondroma along the posteromedial tibia.
